newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank of Portugal forecasts lower 1996 state debt.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Portugal forecasts lower 1996 state debt.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said state debt in 1996 would be 11,743 billion escudos, 122.9 billion less than originally forecast.
The debt would amount to 70.7 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP), the central bank said in its latest quarterly economic report.

It said the change was the result of a revision in how much privatisation revenue was used to pay off debt and a reduction in the amount of company debt the Treasury had to assume. -- Lisbon newsroom +(351-1) 3538254
